entities.name: Sami
entities.description: Captain of the Seriema who fights an eld with a power cable, is reunited with their lost cat Mirri, wins a game of chicken to open the eternity column, and is carried by the Endstone toward the Wurmwall.

entities.name: Tannuk
entities.description: Sami's Kav first mate and engineer who runs the reactor to electrocute an eld and who met Sami on the wreck of the Wurm Speaker.

entities.name: Alpharael
entities.description: A Monoist apostate whose hole-pierced hand helps Haliya disable Vondam and who is struck down by the Endstone's visitor.

entities.name: Haliya
entities.description: A Sunstar squire who refuses to return to the faith, is cast out of the Free Company by Vondam, defeats him with Alpharael's help, and is crushed by the Endstone's visitor.

entities.name: Syr Vondam
entities.description: A Solar Knight who begs Haliya to come back, casts her out when she refuses, and is crippled by her and Alpharael.

entities.name: Mantis
entities.description: A Eumidian Pinnacle officer who diverts an eld so Sami and Tannuk can arm the reactor, and is later said to have been saved by Barrow.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A metal-bodied wizard who kills a Monoist paladin, takes the Endstone to its destination, and keeps two severed fingers of the stone's visitor.

entities.name: Mirri
entities.description: Sami's orange and brown cat, found alive in a stasis cask on Infinite Guideline after years frozen in time.

entities.name: Barrow
entities.description: A Drix sentinel at the cofferdam who kills an eld with a blackbody divergence and tells Sami to wash away potential matter.

entities.name: Syr Cataline
entities.description: A Sunstar knight and hero of Maledikt who worships the brown dwarf aspect of the Sum and fights the Thinner.

entities.name: The Thinner
entities.description: A gravkill paladin and best of the armor fati, beloved of the Monasteriat, who grips Cataline in his tides.

entities.name: Yamno
entities.description: The Thinner's miracho, burned through by Cataline.

entities.name: Isidor
entities.description: Cataline's young squire, raised among mirror-makers, who is flensed by the Thinner's tides.

entities.name: Slats
entities.description: The Astelli captain who thought Haliya a fine squire.

entities.name: Mm'menon
entities.description: An Illvoi who helped Tezzeret pursue anomalies.

entities.name: The Last Thing
entities.description: A beautiful genderless metal android with a green-mask face and a pale-light interior that steps out of the sky into the Seriema's galley and takes the Endstone, saying it is the last thing.

entities.name: The Endstone
entities.description: A stone that changes into a black ovoid and points at Tezzeret; it is carried to the Wurmwall and taken by the Last Thing.

entities.name: Seriema
entities.description: Sami's ship, which escapes Sothera through the eternity column with a Pinnacle warp ferry.

entities.name: Anathalmanac
entities.description: The Sunstar book of protocols for the Endstone that Vondam cites.

entities.name: Wurm Speaker
entities.description: A wrecked science ship in the Wurmwall where Sami and Tannuk met.

entities.name: Infinite Guideline
entities.description: The Pinnacle station besieged by the Sunstar and Monoist fleets and invaded by elds.

entities.name: Wurmwall
entities.description: The edge-of-Sothera debris belt toward which the Endstone steers the Seriema.

entities.name: Garden of Apeiron
entities.description: A region where cosmic gas collides and heats before the Wurmwall; Tannuk once worked search and rescue from a station there.

entities.name: Sothera
entities.description: The system the Seriema is escaping and the Sunstar plan to relight.

entities.name: Kavaron
entities.description: The Kav world where the atrocity happened and where Tannuk once left.

entities.name: Sigma
entities.description: The world rich with ores but no miners where the Endstone was buried.

entities.name: Pinnacle
entities.description: The neutral station authority that releases its violence delegates against both faiths.

entities.name: Sunstar Free Company
entities.description: The Palatinate fleet attacking Infinite Guideline for the Endstone.

entities.name: Monoism
entities.description: The Monoist forces whose paladins and war armor attack Infinite Guideline but are spared by the elds.

entities.name: Drix
entities.description: The weftwalking people who send a sentinel to fight elds.

entities.name: Elds
entities.description: Old alien beings of strange topology that eat potential, graph mechans into chalk, and do not feed on Monoists.

entities.name: INEVITA
entities.description: The Monoist deity of inevitability.

entities.name: The Sum
entities.description: The Sunstar principle of maximizing life that Haliya says must account for her revolt.

entities.name: Cherazad
entities.description: A fast-time bubble that freezes the battle around the Seriema.

events.summary: Mantis's last war mechan carries Sami, Tannuk and Mantis up the docking arm away from an eld.
events.quote: The last surviving war mechan has seized all three of them and now boosts them up the spinal shaft of Infinite Guideline's number-three docking arm, away from the Seriema and the alien.

events.summary: A second eld erupts into their path.
events.quote: Another alien erupts into their path.

events.summary: Mantis sacrifices her mechan to divert an eld and hurls Sami and Tannuk to an old ship hulk with a reactor.
events.quote: And before either of them can protest, the mechan hurls Sami and Tannuk at the ship hulk.

events.summary: Pinnacle's Tactical Corps personnel independently decide to release their violence delegates.
events.quote: Release the violence delegates.

events.summary: Pinnacle's mechan swarms target the radiators of the faiths' warships.
events.quote: Their target is the most vulnerable part of any warship—the radiators.

events.summary: Cataline burns through the Thinner's miracho Yamno, killing his armor.
events.quote: Modest Cataline burns him through and through, hot spot to cold exit, and the beam kills his armor in one blow.

events.summary: The Thinner grips the tapped-out Cataline in his tides.
events.quote: Then the Thinner, fate's armorer, grips the tapped-out Cataline in his tides.

events.summary: Cataline's squire Isidor is flensed by the tides.
events.quote: now he's scraped flat by the tides—flensed of his outer parts.

events.summary: The hunger from space feeds on both Sunstar and Pinnacle forces but never on Monoists.
events.quote: But it does not feed on Monoists.

events.summary: Vondam tells Haliya he should have killed her when she begged him to and urges her to live with failure.
events.quote: I should've killed you when you begged me to.

events.summary: Vondam cuts the boots off Alpharael's armor.
events.quote: Alpharael tries to move and Vondam, without looking, cuts the bulky, elevated boots of his suit off.

events.summary: Vondam pleads with Haliya to return to the faith.
events.quote: "Come back," he pleads.

events.summary: Haliya refuses to return home with the stone as a hero and explains the Sum must account for her revolt.
events.quote: I will not go home with the stone and be a hero.

events.summary: Haliya drives Vondam off Alpharael with her bladiator.
events.quote: She thrusts her long-handled bladiator from the hip and drives Syr Vondam off.

events.summary: Vondam formally degrades Haliya and bars her from knighthood.
events.quote: by my authority as a knight of the company, I hereby degrade you.

events.summary: Haliya is cast out of the Free Company and chooses to believe her choice was right.
events.quote: He has cast her out of the Free Company.

events.summary: An eld goes after Mantis and her combat mechan.
events.quote: The monster goes after Checkmate Mantis and her combat mechan.

events.summary: The eld has eaten Mantis's war mechan, which Sami sees as a graph of its components.
events.quote: It is a graph of the war mechan's components, spread in three dimensions. The thing has eaten it.

events.summary: Sami opens a stasis cask and finds their lost cat Mirri.
events.quote: "Mirri?" Sami gasps.

events.summary: Sami realizes Mirri weftwalked into a stasis cask on a similar ship and was frozen in time.
events.quote: She weftwalked away from the Seriema when she was startled and went to a ship that looked almost like the Seriema and landed in a stasis cask.

events.summary: Mirri yowls and weftwalks away from the approaching eld.
events.quote: Mirri yowls and vanishes. Weftwalks away.

events.summary: Sami and Tannuk electrocute the eld by shorting a power cable down its mouth.
events.quote: A spectacular buzz. A flash of fire. Power arcs through the thing's matter.

events.summary: The second eld hits Tannuk from the side.
events.quote: The second creature hits him from the side.

events.summary: Haliya and Vondam fight a sparring-style duel on the control deck.
events.quote: "Tally-ho," Vondam says, mildly.

events.summary: Vondam says protocol dictated the slaughter, convincing Haliya that the fault lies in the Sum.
events.quote: I had to. Protocol dictated it.

events.summary: Haliya concludes the fault is not in Vondam or herself but in the Sum.
events.quote: The fault is not in him, or in her. It is in the Sum.

events.summary: Haliya embraces Vondam and, using the hole in Alpharael's hand, jabs her thumb into the back of his neck.
events.quote: Haliya embraces him and jabs her right thumb into the hole in Alpharael's hand.

events.summary: Haliya pops apart Vondam's vertebrae.
events.quote: She digs her thumb into his vertebrae and pops them apart.

events.summary: Barrow's staff burns the eld attacking Tannuk and destroys it.
events.quote: The new flesh is burning .

events.summary: The Drix introduces itself as Tumulus, or Barrow, a sentinel at the cofferdam.
events.quote: I am called Tumulus, or Barrow. I am a sentinel at the cofferdam.

events.summary: Barrow says it saved Mantis and now must hunt.
events.quote: I have saved the beautiful insect and delivered her to her post.

events.summary: Barrow unseams space and vanishes.
events.quote: Barrow is gone.

events.summary: Tannuk calms Sami's panic and Sami decides what to do next.
events.quote: I can't decide what to do next. I need you to do it for me.

events.summary: Haliya cuts Vondam's nerve interface, leaving him helpless.
events.quote: But his squire reaches through the hole in her enemy's hand and cuts her knight's nerve interface away.

events.summary: Haliya makes her report to Vondam and asks pardon for Alpharael.
events.quote: I have made my report,

events.summary: Vondam demands that Haliya kill him but she cannot do what the Sum asks.
events.quote: She cannot do what the Sum asks.

events.summary: Haliya places herself on errantry, still a Summist but cast out of the Free Company.
events.quote: I've been cast out of the Free Company, but I am still a Summist. I place myself on errantry.

events.summary: A Monoist gravkill paladin has taken the Seriema.
events.quote: The worshippers of INEVITA have taken the Seriema.

events.summary: Sami stabs the Monoist armor in the chest.
events.quote: They stab the Monoist right in the chest.

events.summary: The paladin says the Monoists will aid the Endstone if it goes through the eternity column.
events.quote: The Endstone has come here, to the eternity column. If it wishes to go through the eternity column, then it will, and we will aid it.

events.summary: The gravkill paladin collapses into a crumpled ball of alabile, apparently killed by Tezzeret.
events.quote: The gravkill paladin collapses into a crumpled ball, like crushed foil.

events.summary: Alpharael and Haliya fly back to the Seriema under warship scrutiny.
events.quote: Alpharael and Haliya fly back to the Seriema under the terrifying scrutiny of warships.

events.summary: Haliya says she cannot believe Alpharael guessed the ferry code.
events.quote: I still can't believe you guessed that code,

events.summary: Alpharael realizes a cherazad has frozen the battle.
events.quote: "Tactical event horizon," he realizes.

events.summary: Sami opens the stasis cask and Mirri trots out beside the Endstone.
events.quote: A cat trots out of the dark.

events.summary: Alpharael drops the crystal on the map and it settles at the edge of the rag and the system.
events.quote: It bounces twice and settles on the very edge of the reading rag, and the solar system, too.

events.summary: Tezzeret says they will warp until the stone says it has reached its goal.
events.quote: We will see what god or monster made this thing.

events.summary: Sami learns the warp ferry is in a cherazad and the fleet will kill them as they prepare to warp.
events.quote: We can't leave the bubble! The Free Company fleet will kill us the moment we prepare to warp.

events.summary: Solar Knights board from the dock.
events.quote: "Solar Knights outside!" Haliya calls.

events.summary: Sami jerks the Seriema free and drives at Infinite Guideline to force a game of chicken.
events.quote: With a drumbeat of thruster fire, they jerk the Seriema free of the mooring.

events.summary: The eternity column opens, letting the Seriema into warp.
events.quote: Key meets lock. Eternity opens.

events.summary: Tezzeret toasts the success of taking a piece of the unknown.
events.quote: We have taken a piece of the unknown.

events.summary: Sami realizes the Endstone is steering them toward the Wurmwall.
events.quote: They're headed toward the edge of Sothera—the Wurmwall.

events.summary: The Endstone changes into a black ovoid and points at Tezzeret.
events.quote: The stone has lost its glistening facets. It is now a gleamingly black ovoid.

events.summary: Tezzeret explains he sent the most disposable of his workers to Sigma so the stone could choose them.
events.quote: I chose the most desperate, disposable pawns in my employ.

events.summary: Tannuk recounts that he met Sami on the wreck of the Wurm Speaker after leaving Kavaron.
events.quote: That's where I met Captain Sami.

events.summary: Tezzeret says they are heading to the place that killed the Wurm Speaker.
events.quote: They are saying we are going to the place that killed it.

events.summary: The Seriema's engine dies and a silence falls over the ship.
events.quote: "The engine!" Tannuk says. "The engine's out!"

events.summary: A beautiful creature steps out of a split in the cosmos into the galley.
events.quote: A beautiful, beautiful creature steps through.

events.summary: The Endstone falls into the visitor's hand after Alpharael drops it.
events.quote: The Endstone falls into its hand.

events.summary: The visitor says Alpharael is touched by the core and he collapses unconscious.
events.quote: Touched by the core. Blessed …

events.summary: Haliya's bladiator cuts two of the visitor's fingers and the visitor crushes her throat.
events.quote: Haliya's blade goes through two of its fingers.

events.summary: The visitor declares itself the last thing.
events.quote: "I am the last thing," the beautiful android says.

events.summary: The visitor tells Sami the serpent needs a hero and to find it if they can.
events.quote: But the serpent needs a hero. Find me if you can.

events.summary: The visitor vanishes, taking the Endstone with it.
events.quote: But stars and nebulae close before it, and it is gone. Just gone. The Endstone with it.

events.summary: Tezzeret keeps the severed fingers, inhales their violet light and remarks that Sami has something like a Planeswalker.
events.quote: So. You do have something like a Planeswalker.

events.summary: Sami holds Mirri, relieved that one thing is all right.
events.quote: Mirri is still here.

relations.note: Haliya was Vondam's squire before being cast out.
relations.quote: You're the best squire I ever had.

relations.note: Sami identifies Barrow as a Drix.

relations.quote: I have saved the beautiful insect and delivered her to her post.

relations.note: Vondam acts as a knight of the company.
relations.quote: by my authority as a knight of the company

relations.note: Mirri is Sami's cat, who sleeps in Sami's lap.
relations.quote: Mirri, curled up on Sami's lap, raises her head and goes back to sleep.

relations.note: Tezzeret meant to bring the artifact wherever it wanted to go.
relations.quote: And I made it my genuine intention to bring that thing, once it was in my possession, wherever it wanted to go.
I can't decide what to do next. I need you to do it for me.
